selection: Choose the first coherent model-proposed option in report order; include all additive edits in that option. Do not combine mutually exclusive alternatives, switch after re-review, or use Gold to generate edits.
conditional_author: Synthetic case author is Codex maintainer model, not a claimed human or inferred real author.
scope_rule: Record numerical input-domain and protocol-budget changes separately. changed_clear_semantics refers to changes to previously clear non-defective input/output or model rules beyond the defect being repaired. Author approval does not conceal such changes.
coverage_adjustment: Two redundant typo targets replaced by communication/simulation before any independent repair re-review.
paired_extension_reason: Evaluate repair effectiveness on the same 20 roots for both Skill versions, so absolute success is not mistaken for evidence of improvement. Registered before any candidate re-review; all first candidates retained.
